installHints.generic: Open the site in a supported browser (Chrome, Edge, Safari) and use the menu to install the app.
installHints.ios: Tap the Share button (□↑) at the bottom of the screen, then choose “Add to Home Screen”.
installHints.androidChrome: Open the browser menu (⋮) → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
installHints.android: Open the browser menu and look for “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
installHints.desktopChrome: Click the install icon in the address bar on the right, or open the menu (⋮) → “Install sovlium”.
installHints.safari: In the File menu choose “Add to Dock” (macOS), or use Share → “Add to Home Screen” on iPad.
installHints.firefox: In the browser menu (≡) choose “Install” or “Install sovlium” if available.
installHints.fallback: Use the browser menu to install the app, or open the site in Chrome/Edge and refresh the page.
